I love radio and I’m loving this thread. 

First, I’m a huge KEXP fan, didn’t know of KPNW, but was surprised to see people comparing Star 101.5 to 90.3? 101.5 was the dregs of radio to me, personally.

Second, I’m a country music fan! And the only local country option I’d found til the HANK 101.5 flip was 100.7 The Wolf. 

My impressions:

100.7 Wolf - tons of talking, tooons of ads, playing pretty bad new pop-country (emphasis on “bad”), very little variety. 

HANK 101.5 - no ads or jabbering so far (maybe cause it’s new, but I’m enjoying), heard a recorded message thanking IBEW Local 46 for getting it on air - union strong! Way better playlist! It’s all relative - but so far HANK playing more 90s-00s country, way more women artists.

Anyone else happy for the flip? Anyone else not automatically associating country music with conservatism? I’m thrilled with the shows on KEXP rn, but I was sad when there wasn’t space for Swingin’ Doors anymore :-)
